pairs.difference: A has a clear bright upper plane and a deeper shadow beneath the round chamber. B's chamber and long body have gentler, more uniform shading, with less separation between light and shadow.
pairs.fix: Brighten the whistle's upper-facing surface and deepen the shadow beneath its round chamber; keep a soft transition across the curved side.

pairs.difference: Both horns have bright bell rims, broad highlights along the tubing, and deep shading inside the bell. B's stronger highlight inside the bell remains consistent with the real cards' lighting range.

A's cup exterior stays broadly dim and evenly shaded despite its dark cast shadow. B has a bright upper-right rim and handle, a clear turn into shadow on the left, and stronger contact darkening beneath the cup.
pairs.fix: Give the cup a bright upper-right rim and handle, with a broad light patch on the right wall fading into deeper shadow on the left.

pairs.difference: Both baskets show rounded light-to-shadow transitions on the apples, bright upper handle strands, and dark contact shadows between the woven strips. Their cast shadows fall in different directions, but neither lighting treatment clearly departs from the references.

A's barrel turns gradually from a broad lit left face into its shaded right side. B has a stronger dark-left/bright-right split, with conspicuously bright right-hand sections of the hoops and a deeper shadow across the left staves.
pairs.fix: Soften the barrel's dark-left/bright-right split, open the shadowed staves slightly, and broaden the highlights across the metal hoops.

pairs.difference: A retains readable shading across the doors, fenders, and bumper. B concentrates a nearly white sheen across the roof and hood while the lower doors and wheel arches drop into much deeper shadow.
pairs.fix: Reduce the white sheen across the roof and hood, and add soft reflected light to the lower doors, wheel arches, and bumper.

pairs.difference: A's large tent panel carries a broad, gradual light transition, with a shaded entrance and visible reflected light near the ground. B's left panel stays comparatively uniform and dark while the front flaps carry narrow, intense highlights beside the black entrance.
pairs.fix: Spread a broad soft light across the large tent panel, soften the bright strips on the entrance flaps, and add a little reflected ground light inside the opening.

pairs.difference: A's pot has a restrained upper-left sheen and localized illumination near the fire. B has a much broader pale highlight across the pot's upper-left belly and strongly illuminated support poles, making the overhead illumination dominate the form.
pairs.fix: Narrow and dim the pale highlight on the pot, soften the bright faces of the support poles, and keep the fire's glow concentrated beneath the pot.

pattern: Generated cards often replace the references' broad, readable form turns with either weak, uniform shading or an exaggerated bright patch against a deep shadow. Highlight placement and shadow fill are stronger clues than overall darkness.
